title: Changelog
text: Installable R package workflow: Promoted HistoneMod hosted Shiny application workflow installable local R package workflow routine end-user use. Public package API: Exposed focused user-facing API including depends_check(), runHistoneMod(), histonemod_app(), percentage_calculation(), plot_pca(), plot_heatmap(), plot_barplot_single(). Optional dependency repair pak: Added depends_check(install_missing = TRUE) support missing dependencies can installed pak, including mixed CRAN Bioconductor dependency management. Package vignette: Added simplified user vignette package installation, local Shiny launch, input requirements, basic workflow guidance. R package documentation set: Added package-level function-level documentation exported workflow analysis helpers.

title: Changelog
text: Version upgrade 0.6.2: Updated package version metadata internal fallback version strings reflect package release transition. Dependency declaration strategy: Moved primary dependency installation story DESCRIPTION keeping depends_check() user-invoked verification repair helper. Export surface reduction: Reduced exported namespace end-user startup, dependency, calculation, plotting functions instead exposing broad collection internal helpers. README positioning: Reframed project professional R package users install locally, rather online hosted Shiny service. Package metadata: Refined DESCRIPTION title description text better match standard R package CRAN-style metadata expectations.

title: Changelog
text: README overhaul: Rewrote README.md emphasize package installation, local application launch, input requirements, exported API, dependency handling. Vignette simplification: Simplified vignette focuses default user journey installing package launching bundled Shiny application. Roxygen documentation updates: Improved roxygen comments R/functions.R, R/histonemod-app.R, R/server.R, R/ui.R, package-level documentation cleaner help output. Manual help-page synchronization: Updated man/*.Rd files keep installed help pages aligned revised exported functions package narrative. AI-generated changelog attribution: Explicitly recorded 0.6.2 changelog entry automatically generated AI agent.

title: Changelog
text: Quick PDF report (A4 landscape): Added multi-page PDF report generator cover page, data source summary, PCA, Heatmap, Barplot pages. PDF cover enhancements: Cover now includes current R version (auto-inserted) configurable cover layout. Central PDF configuration (pdf_cfg): Added single config list control page size, margins, header/footer, cover layout, per-plot target sizes. Barplot paging/layout logic: Barplots automatically paginated per protein laid configurable grid.

title: Changelog
text: Vector-first PDF rendering: PDF plots drawn directly vector graphics (intermediate PNG embedding) better quality faster generation. PDF-aware font scaling: Heatmap Barplot font sizes scaled PDF rendering reduce overlaps plots fitted smaller viewports. Export UX improvements: Export dialogs use fixed-size preview frame object-fit: contain include Zoom preview view. Export defaults match -screen size: Default export Width/Height derived current plot output size (rounded inches). Annotation/typography refinements: Barplot significance brackets/stars ANOVA label sizing/spacing tuned improve readability.

title: Changelog
text: Prevented download-related crashes: Hardened numeric parsing wrapped download/report generation error handling failures terminate Shiny session. robust PDF generation: Page-level error trapping writes readable failure message PDF instead aborting whole report.
